name: orchestra
description: Orchestrator (run it on Fable): queues tasks, sizes each session (model, effort), routes a request to its repo or to a non-git target, applies the rules of the workspace (orchestra.json) a repo sits in, inits a non-git folder locally, runs the checks itself before a review, runs extra tasks of a repo in local clones, learns its sizing from past tasks, runs one task per background session with a role agent, reviews with a reviewer agent, redispatches until approved
